title: Everyday Phrases — Lying Awake at Night
title_quote: Are you still awake, my love?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】😴 實用「睡不著」必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡800句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 800 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Lying Awake at Night
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「睡不著」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。場景是深夜的臥室：躺著翻身、看時鐘、坐起來倒半杯溫水、熱牛奶加蜂蜜、讓手機離床遠一點、寫下明天的事、數呼吸放鬆肩膀、翻兩頁紙質書，最後重新關燈躺好。800 句循環聽，A2 程度，零基礎也能跟著開口說。常用句型包含描述睡不著、身體的感覺、請另一半小聲一點、一起計畫明天。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'Lying Awake at Night' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). The scene is a bedroom late at night: turning over, glancing at the clock, sitting up for half a glass of warm water, warm milk with honey, moving the phone far from the bed, writing tomorrow's list, counting breaths and relaxing the shoulders, reading two pages of a paper book, then switching the lamp off and lying back down. 800 lines on repeat, A2 level, easy to repeat out loud even from zero.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you still awake, my love?
dialogue.zh: 你還沒睡嗎，親愛的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I was just drifting off.
dialogue.zh: 我剛剛才要迷迷糊糊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time does your clock say?
dialogue.zh: 你的時鐘現在幾點了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost one twenty in the morning.
dialogue.zh: 快凌晨一點二十了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I turned over three times already.
dialogue.zh: 我已經翻了三次身了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too, this bed feels warm.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，這張床暖暖的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I open the window a bit?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ ˈoʊpən ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ə bɪt/
dialogue.zh: 窗子開一點點好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, street noise comes right in.
dialogue.zh: 不要，車聲會直接跑進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My feet are cold under the blanket.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ fit ɑr koʊld ˈʌndər ðə ˈblæŋkɪt/
dialogue.zh: 毯子底下我的腳好冷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull it up over your legs.
dialogue.zh: 把毯子往上拉蓋住腿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This pillow is too flat tonight.
dialogue.zh: 今晚這顆枕頭太扁了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the soft one in the closet.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ðə sɔft wʌn ɪn ðə ˈklɑsət/
dialogue.zh: 櫃子裡那顆軟的可以試試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you hear that hum outside?
dialogue.zh: 你聽到外面那聲嗡嗡了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the fridge running again.
dialogue.zh: 只是冰箱又在運轉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fan clicks every hour, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fæn klɪks ˈɛvri ˈaʊər aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 風扇每小時都會響一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me unplug it for you.
dialogue.zh: 我幫你把它插頭拔掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six thirty alarm, like always?
dialogue.zh: 鬧鐘設六點半，跟平常一樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, set and checked twice.
dialogue.zh: 設好了，還檢查了兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six thirty feels so far away.
dialogue.zh: 六點半感覺好遙遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close your eyes, my dear.
dialogue.zh: 閉上眼睛吧，親愛的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I closed my eyes for ten minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kloʊzd maɪ aɪz fɔr tɛn ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 我閉眼睛閉了十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And then you started to move.
dialogue.zh: 然後你又開始動來動去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Counting hours only makes me worse.
dialogue.zh: 數時間只會讓我更煩躁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then hide the clock, do not look.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn haɪd ðə klɑk du nɑt lʊk/
dialogue.zh: 那就把時鐘遮起來，別看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The red numbers are too bright.
dialogue.zh: 紅色的數字太亮了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My hand can cover them now.
dialogue.zh: 我用手就能擋住它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your side smells like clean soap.
dialogue.zh: 你那一邊聞起來像乾淨的肥皂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the new sheet you bought.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə nu ʃit ju bɔt/
dialogue.zh: 那是你新買的床單啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kicked the sheet off two times.
dialogue.zh: 床單被我踢掉了兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, let me pull it back up.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr lɛt mi pʊl ɪt bæk ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 來，我幫你拉回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the room too warm for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə rum tu wɔrm fɔr ju/
dialogue.zh: 房間對你來說太熱了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am fine under this blanket.
dialogue.zh: 我蓋這條毯子剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My neck hurts from this position.
dialogue.zh: 這個姿勢讓我的脖子好痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move a little closer to me.
dialogue.zh: 往我這邊挪過來一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The wall is thin here, remember?
dialogue.zh: 這裡的牆壁很薄，你記得嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we must keep our voices low.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wi mʌst kip ˈaʊər ˈvɔɪsəz loʊ/
dialogue.zh: 知道，說話要很小聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, I did not mean to wake you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri aɪ dɪd nɑt min tə weɪk ju/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我不是故意吵醒你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You did wake me at twelve.
dialogue.zh: 你十二點就把我叫醒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yawned so loud, sorry about that.
dialogue.zh: 剛剛哈欠打得好大聲，對不起。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yawn quietly next time, please.
dialogue.zh: 下次打哈欠小聲一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The ceiling has a small crack.
dialogue.zh: 天花板上有一條小裂縫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You always stare at that crack.
dialogue.zh: 你每次都盯著那條裂縫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It looks like a sleeping cat.
dialogue.zh: 它看起來像一隻睡著的貓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Funny at one twenty in the dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfʌni æt wʌn ˈtwɛnti ɪn ðə dɑrk/
dialogue.zh: 一點二十了，還黑著燈講笑話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One twenty, I cannot believe it.
dialogue.zh: 一點二十，我實在不敢相信。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Believe it, the night is long.
dialogue.zh: 是真的，夜還很長呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe my brain forgot to stop.
dialogue.zh: 也許是我的腦袋忘了停下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your brain is only very tired.
dialogue.zh: 你的腦袋只是太累了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All night I thought about work.
dialogue.zh: 我一整晚都在想工作的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Work can wait until morning.
dialogue.zh: 工作可以等到早上再說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn the lamp off, too much light.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ðə læmp ɔf tu mʌtʃ laɪt/
dialogue.zh: 把燈關了吧，光太強了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which switch, the one by the door?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ swɪtʃ ðə wʌn baɪ ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 哪個開關，門邊那一個嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The small one near your pillow.
dialogue.zh: 你枕頭旁邊那顆小的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, now the room is dim.
dialogue.zh: 關好了，房間變暗暗的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dim is kinder to my eyes.
dialogue.zh: 暗暗的對眼睛比較好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can you see the door now?
dialogue.zh: 你現在看得到門嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I see only your dark shape.
dialogue.zh: 我只看得到你的黑影。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is me, lying beside you.
dialogue.zh: 那就是我，躺在你旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your breathing is so slow.
dialogue.zh: 你的呼吸好慢喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not asleep yet, I promise.
dialogue.zh: 我還沒睡著，我保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So you were awake with me.
dialogue.zh: 所以你也一直陪著我醒著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only for the last ten minutes.
dialogue.zh: 只有最後那十分鐘而已。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten minutes is a long time.
dialogue.zh: 十分鐘其實很久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Waiting makes ten feel like thirty.
dialogue.zh: 等著睡的時候，十分鐘像三十分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Counting backwards, where did I stop?
dialogue.zh: 倒著數，我數到哪裡斷掉了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You stopped at ninety eight.
dialogue.zh: 你在九十八那裡停住的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ninety eight, then it went blank.
dialogue.zh: 九十八，然後腦袋一片空白。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Numbers never help me either.
dialogue.zh: 數數字對我也都沒有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sheep did nothing for me.
dialogue.zh: 數羊對我一點用也沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then count the rain on glass.
dialogue.zh: 那你來數窗上的雨聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that rain on the window?
dialogue.zh: 窗戶上的是雨聲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft drops, falling very slow.
dialogue.zh: 雨滴很輕，下得好慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rain makes the bed feel smaller.
dialogue.zh: 下雨讓這張床變小了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smaller means cozy, come closer.
dialogue.zh: 變小比較溫暖，靠過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hall light is still on.
dialogue.zh: 走廊的燈還亮著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will shut it after this.
dialogue.zh: 等一下我就去關掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Careful, the floor feels cold.
dialogue.zh: 小心一點，地板好冰。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then give me your warm socks.
dialogue.zh: 那你把溫的襪子給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These socks are still warm.
dialogue.zh: 這雙襪子還溫溫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, my toes thank you.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我的腳趾謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The mattress keeps my old shape.
dialogue.zh: 床墊還留著我舊時的形狀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It knows you better than me.
dialogue.zh: 它比我更認識你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rolled all the way to the edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /roʊld ɔl ðə weɪ tə ði ɛdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 我整個滾到床緣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not fall off, stay here.
dialogue.zh: 別掉下去，留下來這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold on, who moved a chair up there?
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɑn hu muvd ə tʃɛr ʌp ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 等一下，誰在樓上搬椅子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nobody lives upstairs now.
dialogue.zh: 樓上現在都沒人住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Old houses talk all night long.
dialogue.zh: 老房子整晚都在吱吱響。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let them talk, you close your eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ðɛm tɔk ju kloʊz jɔr aɪz/
dialogue.zh: 讓它響，你閉你的眼睛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lying still feels like doing nothing.
dialogue.zh: 躺著不動感覺什麼也沒做。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Doing nothing is rest, you know.
dialogue.zh: 什麼也不做就是休息啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Resting is not the same thing.
dialogue.zh: 休息跟睡覺還是不一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It helps the body, trust me.
dialogue.zh: 它也能放鬆身體，相信我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shoulders are up by my ears.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈʃoʊldərz ɑr ʌp baɪ maɪ ɪrz/
dialogue.zh: 我的肩膀聳到耳朵旁邊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drop them slowly, let them fall.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢放下來，讓它們垂著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better, now my neck feels loose.
dialogue.zh: 好多了，我的脖子鬆了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See, small things can help.
dialogue.zh: 你看，小事也是有幫助的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almost two, the clock just blinked.
dialogue.zh: 快兩點了，時鐘剛剛閃了一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not read it, just lie down.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt rid ɪt dʒʌst laɪ daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 別去讀它，先躺好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My throat feels dry from talking.
dialogue.zh: 講了這麼久，我的喉嚨好乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is water on the table.
dialogue.zh: 桌上還有半杯水呀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will sit up for a second.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl sɪt ʌp fɔr ə ˈsɛkənd/
dialogue.zh: 我先慢慢坐起來一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slowly, the room may spin.
dialogue.zh: 慢一點，頭可能會暈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The floor is cold on my feet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə flɔr ɪz koʊld ɑn maɪ fit/
dialogue.zh: 地板踩起來好冰。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your slippers wait by the bed.
dialogue.zh: 你的拖鞋就在床旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My left toe met the table leg.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ lɛft toʊ mɛt ðə ˈteɪbəl lɛɡ/
dialogue.zh: 我的左腳趾撞到桌腳了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ouch, I know that spot well.
dialogue.zh: 哎喲，那個位置我很熟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is that table always moving?
dialogue.zh: 那張桌子怎麼一直在動？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You bumped it in the dark.
dialogue.zh: 是你在黑黑的地方撞到它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn on the small hall light?
dialogue.zh: 開一下走廊那顆小燈好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, bright light wakes you more.
dialogue.zh: 不要，強光會讓你更清醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will use my phone light.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl juz maɪ foʊn laɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那我就用手機照一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No screens, remember the rule.
dialogue.zh: 不準看螢幕，記得這條規則。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine, I will creep to the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn aɪ wɪl krip tə ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 好吧，那我摸著走到門口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold the wall, it is a short walk.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ðə wɔl ɪt ɪz ə ʃɔrt wɔk/
dialogue.zh: 扶著牆，只有幾步路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kitchen tiles are freezing at night.
dialogue.zh: 廚房地磚在半夜冰得嚇人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put the mat down, then step.
dialogue.zh: 先把墊子放下，再踩下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the kettle, left or right?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz ðə ˈkɛtl lɛft ɔr raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 水壺在哪裡，左邊還是右邊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Left, beside the clean cups.
dialogue.zh: 左邊，在乾淨的杯子旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm water from the tap is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm ˈwɔtər frʌm ðə tæp ɪz faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 水龍頭裝溫水就可以了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or I can heat a cup for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔr aɪ kæn hit ə kʌp fɔr ju/
dialogue.zh: 不然我也可以幫你熱一杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only half a glass, not full.
dialogue.zh: 只倒半杯，不要倒滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half is right, a full one wakes you.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ɪz raɪt ə fʊl wʌn weɪks ju/
dialogue.zh: 半杯就對了，倒滿反而要上廁所。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I get up twice in the night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ ɡɛt ʌp twaɪs ɪn ðə naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那樣我半夜要爬起來兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So keep the cup by the bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ kip ðə kʌp baɪ ðə bɛd/
dialogue.zh: 所以杯子就放在床邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This water has the right temperature.
dialogue.zh: 這杯水的溫度剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not hot, not cold, just lukewarm.
dialogue.zh: 不燙也不涼，就是溫溫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My dry throat feels better.
dialogue.zh: 我乾乾的喉嚨舒服多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sip slowly, it takes time.
dialogue.zh: 小口喝，這需要一點時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My legs went numb from lying.
dialogue.zh: 我的腿躺到麻麻的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand a second, they will wake.
dialogue.zh: 站一下，它們一下子就醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I lean on the counter here?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ lin ɑn ðə ˈkaʊntər hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 我可以靠在流理台邊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is right behind you.
dialogue.zh: 可以，它就在你背後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your kitchen window shows the street.
dialogue.zh: 廚房這扇窗看出去就是馬路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No cars yet, only the moon.
dialogue.zh: 還沒有車，只有月亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One car went by, then nothing.
dialogue.zh: 一輛車開過去，然後什麼都沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See, the street stays very quiet.
dialogue.zh: 你看，街上一直很安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fridge hums a low song.
dialogue.zh: 冰箱哼著低低的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That humming is kind of nice.
dialogue.zh: 那嗡嗡聲其實滿好聽的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kitchen clock says two ten there.
dialogue.zh: 廚房的鐘寫著兩點十分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not add it up, please.
dialogue.zh: 拜託，別再算還剩幾小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I added it, four hours left.
dialogue.zh: 我算好了，只剩四個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let those hours walk alone.
dialogue.zh: 那就讓這幾個小時自己走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water fixed my throat, not my head.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔtər fɪkst maɪ θroʊt nɑt maɪ hɛd/
dialogue.zh: 水治好了我的喉嚨，治不好腦袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your head still runs too fast.
dialogue.zh: 你的腦袋還是轉得太快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sit on the stool, rest a minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt ɑn ðə stul rɛst ə ˈmɪnɪt/
dialogue.zh: 先坐在凳子上休息一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, I brought the small chair.
dialogue.zh: 來，我把小椅子搬來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want water too, my dear?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju wɑnt ˈwɔtər tu maɪ dɪr/
dialogue.zh: 你也想喝點水嗎，親愛的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, half a cup for me.
dialogue.zh: 好呀，我喝半杯就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My glass is empty already.
dialogue.zh: 我那一杯已經喝空了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more sip, then back to bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr sɪp ðɛn bæk tə bɛd/
dialogue.zh: 再一口，然後就回床上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Standing up makes me dizzy again.
dialogue.zh: 一站起來我就覺得頭暈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe once, then hold the counter.
dialogue.zh: 先呼吸一次，再扶著流理台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That tap drips all night long.
dialogue.zh: 那個水龍頭整晚都在滴水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will fix it this weekend.
dialogue.zh: 這個週末我們來修它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Each drip counts another minute.
dialogue.zh: 每一滴都在幫我數時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ignore it, drink your water.
dialogue.zh: 別理它，喝你的水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water tastes better at two.
dialogue.zh: 兩點喝的水比較好喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flat in the daylight, you mean.
dialogue.zh: 你是說白天喝起來沒味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This cup has a small crack.
dialogue.zh: 這杯子上也有一條小裂縫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same shape as your ceiling friend.
dialogue.zh: 形狀跟你天花板那位朋友一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will finish this warm half.
dialogue.zh: 我把這溫溫的半杯喝完。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, the blanket still waits.
dialogue.zh: 好，被子還在等你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I have your last sip?
dialogue.zh: 我能喝你最後那口嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is yours, I have my own.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz jɔrz aɪ hæv maɪ on/
dialogue.zh: 給你，我還有我自己那杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands were cold, the cup helped.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hændz wɜr koʊld ðə kʌp hɛlpt/
dialogue.zh: 我的手剛剛好冰，有杯子就有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A warm cup is a hand heater.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə wɔrm kʌp ɪz ə hænd ˈhitər/
dialogue.zh: 熱杯子就像暖手的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The floor sounds louder at night.
dialogue.zh: 地板的聲音在夜裡比較大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old boards, they talk after ten.
dialogue.zh: 舊地板啊，十點過後就會說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hall mirror jumped at me.
dialogue.zh: 走廊的鏡子嚇了我一跳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That was only your wild hair.
dialogue.zh: 那只是你亂七八糟的頭髮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hair stands up on one side.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hɛr stændz ʌp ɑn wʌn saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 我一邊的頭髮全部翹起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That looks exactly like a nest.
dialogue.zh: 那看起來真的很像鳥窩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two steps left, then the bed.
dialogue.zh: 只剩兩步就到床邊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will carry the empty bottle.
dialogue.zh: 空瓶子我幫你拿過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The room smells like rain now.
dialogue.zh: 房間現在聞起來有雨的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open the window just a little.
dialogue.zh: 窗子只開一點點就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But you said the street noise comes.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ju sɛd ðə strit nɔɪz kʌmz/
dialogue.zh: 可是你剛說車聲會跑進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rain covers it, listen a second.
dialogue.zh: 雨聲把它蓋掉了，你聽一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a soft sound, indeed.
dialogue.zh: 這確實是很輕柔的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like water falling on leaves.
dialogue.zh: 像水落在葉子上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Leaves? What tree, at this hour?
dialogue.zh: 葉子？這時候哪來的樹？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The big one outside our window.
dialogue.zh: 就是我們窗外那棵大的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My water is done, I am coming.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈwɔtər ɪz dʌn aɪ æm ˈkʌmɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我的水喝完了，我過去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave the cup, I will wash it.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ðə kʌp aɪ wɪl wɑʃ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 杯子放著就好，我來洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bed still holds your warm shape.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛd stɪl hoʊldz jɔr wɔrm ʃeɪp/
dialogue.zh: 床上還留著你溫暖的形狀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It waited for you, get in.
dialogue.zh: 它在等你啊，快躺上來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I kicked the blanket, sorry again.
dialogue.zh: 我又把被子踢開了，抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I fixed it, just climb under.
dialogue.zh: 我整理好了，你鑽進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cool side or warm side tonight?
dialogue.zh: 今晚要睡涼的那邊還是溫的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cool is yours, I took warm.
dialogue.zh: 涼的給你，我拿溫的那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I am thirsty in an hour?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt ɪf aɪ æm ˈθɜrsti ɪn ən ˈaʊər/
dialogue.zh: 如果一個小時後我又渴了呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bottle stays within your reach.
dialogue.zh: 水瓶就放在你手邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water was nice, but not enough.
dialogue.zh: 水是不錯，不過還是不夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Milk may do more for sleep.
dialogue.zh: 牛奶對睡覺可能更有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We need milk from the fridge.
dialogue.zh: 我們需要冰箱裡的牛奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And honey from the top shelf.
dialogue.zh: 還有最上面那一層的蜂蜜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more trip to the kitchen?
dialogue.zh: 還要再跑一趟廚房嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but this time in slippers.
dialogue.zh: 要，不過這回要穿拖鞋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will sit here and wait.
dialogue.zh: 我先坐在這裡等你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait here, I will be right back.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt hɪr aɪ wɪl bi raɪt bæk/
dialogue.zh: 你在這裡等，我一下子就回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the small pot on the stove?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə smɔl pɑt ɑn ðə stoʊv/
dialogue.zh: 小鍋放到爐上了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and the milk is in it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd ðə mɪlk ɪz ɪn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 放了，牛奶已經在鍋裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Low flame, we do not want a boil.
dialogue.phonetic: /loʊ fleɪm wi du nɑt wɑnt ə bɔɪl/
dialogue.zh: 小火就好，我們不要把它煮滾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know, a skin forms if it boils.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ ə skɪn fɔrmz ɪf ɪt bɔɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 我知道，煮滾會結一層奶皮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stir it slow with the wooden spoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɜr ɪt sloʊ wɪð ðə ˈwʊdən spun/
dialogue.zh: 用木湯匙慢慢攪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stirring now, it smells so good.
dialogue.zh: 正在攪，聞起來好香。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much honey for one cup?
dialogue.zh: 一杯要放多少蜂蜜？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just one spoon, maybe less.
dialogue.zh: 一匙就夠，也許還可以少一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that jar heavy to open?
dialogue.zh: 那罐蜂蜜的蓋子很緊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twist twice, the lid is loose.
dialogue.zh: 轉兩下就好，蓋子鬆鬆的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My fingers are sticky now.
dialogue.zh: 我的手指都黏黏的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Run them under the cool tap.
dialogue.zh: 去水龍頭下沖一沖手吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The honey fell in a long thread.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈhʌni fɛl ɪn ə lɔŋ θrɛd/
dialogue.zh: 蜂蜜拉成一條細細的線落下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the best part of it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə bɛst pɑrt ʌv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那是整個過程最好看的部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is gold in the white milk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɡoʊld ɪn ðə waɪt mɪlk/
dialogue.zh: 金黃色落在白色的牛奶裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn it once, the honey melts.
dialogue.zh: 攪一下就好，蜂蜜會化開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ready, pour it in my cup.
dialogue.zh: 好了，倒進我的杯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half again, or a little more?
dialogue.zh: 再半杯，還是多一點？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A little more, my cup is big.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl mɔr maɪ kʌp ɪz bɪɡ/
dialogue.zh: 多一點，我的杯子比較大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, the cup is hot now.
dialogue.zh: 小心，杯子現在很燙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both hands wrap around it now.
dialogue.zh: 兩只手把杯子層層圍住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like a warm stone in winter.
dialogue.zh: 像冬天裡的一顆暖石頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sit by the window, drink here.
dialogue.zh: 坐到窗邊來喝吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The rain stopped while you cooked.
dialogue.zh: 你煮的時候，雨停了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The street looks clean after rain.
dialogue.zh: 雨後的馬路看起來好乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the milk smells like home.
dialogue.zh: 牛奶的氣味也像在家裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My grandmother made this for me.
dialogue.zh: 我小時候都是奶奶煮給我喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With honey, or with sugar?
dialogue.zh: 她加蜂蜜還是加糖？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only honey, sugar wakes you up.
dialogue.zh: 只加蜂蜜，她說糖會讓人有精神。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: White sugar, brown sugar, same thing.
dialogue.zh: 白糖紅糖，其實都一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This milk is perfect, thank you.
dialogue.zh: 這杯牛奶很完美，謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You made the honey part, remember?
dialogue.zh: 加蜂蜜那一步是你做的呀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A small mustache is on my lip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə smɔl ˈmʌstæʃ ɪz ɑn maɪ lɪp/
dialogue.zh: 我的嘴唇上有一圈牛奶鬍子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very handsome, do not wipe it.
dialogue.zh: 很帥啊，先別擦掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You drank half in one second.
dialogue.zh: 你兩三下就喝了一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It was warm, I could not stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wəz wɔrm aɪ kʊd nɑt stɑp/
dialogue.zh: 因為是溫的，我停不下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then slow down, sip like me.
dialogue.zh: 那你慢一點，像我這樣小口喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Easy for you, yours is bigger.
dialogue.zh: 你說得輕鬆，你那杯比較大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half for you, I will pour back.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf fɔr ju aɪ wɪl pɔr bæk/
dialogue.zh: 分一半給你，我幫你倒回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, keep it, I am full now.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ kip ɪt aɪ æm fʊl naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 不用，你留著，我喝飽了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pot has one sip left.
dialogue.zh: 鍋裡只剩下最後一口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it to the plant outside.
dialogue.zh: 倒給外面那一盆植物吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our plant will love warm milk.
dialogue.zh: 我們那盆植物會愛上溫牛奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It loves everything we eat.
dialogue.zh: 它什麼東西都愛吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bring the tray, I drink in bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ðə treɪ aɪ drɪŋk ɪn bɛd/
dialogue.zh: 把托盤拿來，我在床上喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm milk stays good a while.
dialogue.zh: 溫牛奶可以撐一下下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tray makes a small sound.
dialogue.zh: 托盤放下去輕輕響了一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wood on wood, the table is old.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ɑn wʊd ðə ˈteɪbəl ɪz oʊld/
dialogue.zh: 木頭碰木頭，這桌子很舊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two more sips, then it is done.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu mɔr sɪps ðɛn ɪt ɪz dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 再兩口就喝完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sweet at the end, like honey.
dialogue.zh: 最後一口是甜的，像蜂蜜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My tongue stays sweet now.
dialogue.zh: 我的舌頭還是甜甜的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rinse with water, then come back.
dialogue.zh: 用溫水漱一下，再回來躺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wash the pot, I will take the cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑʃ ðə pɑt aɪ wɪl teɪk ðə kʌp/
dialogue.zh: 你去洗鍋子，我收杯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, warm water kills the milk.
dialogue.zh: 好，溫水才洗得掉牛奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The honey lid is still open.
dialogue.zh: 蜂蜜的蓋子還開著沒關。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close it, or ants will visit.
dialogue.zh: 關起來，不然螞蟻會來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No ants in our apartment, relax.
dialogue.zh: 我們這棟公寓沒有螞蟻，放寬心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I will leave it open.
dialogue.zh: 那我就這樣開著不管了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bed first, then the light off.
dialogue.zh: 先上床，然後再把燈關掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your pillow looks flat again.
dialogue.zh: 你的枕頭看起來又扁扁的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Flip it, the other side is cool.
dialogue.phonetic: /flɪp ɪt ði ˈʌðər saɪd ɪz kul/
dialogue.zh: 翻過來，另一面是涼的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, that is your cool pillow.
dialogue.zh: 好了，這面涼的給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Milk in me, blanket on me.
dialogue.zh: 牛奶在肚子裡，被子蓋在身上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the whole recipe.
dialogue.zh: 這就是全部的祕方了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My stomach feels calm now.
dialogue.zh: 我的胃現在很安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Calm is enough for tonight.
dialogue.zh: 今晚能這樣就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bed likes me better at two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛd laɪks mi ˈbɛtər æt tu/
dialogue.zh: 床好像比較喜歡兩點鐘的我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bed is patient, it waits.
dialogue.zh: 床很有耐心，它會等你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lie down beside me, you worked.
dialogue.zh: 你辛苦了，快躺到我這邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will lie down in one minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl laɪ daʊn ɪn wʌn ˈmɪnɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我再收一下就躺下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your hands smell like warm honey.
dialogue.zh: 你的手上聞起來是溫蜂蜜的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then come here and hold my hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn kʌm hɪr ænd hoʊld maɪ hænd/
dialogue.zh: 那你過來，牽我的手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This blanket is heavy and good.
dialogue.zh: 這條被子又重又舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Heavy keeps the dreams inside.
dialogue.zh: 重一點可以把夢留住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dreams, please, any dreams tonight.
dialogue.zh: 拜託，今晚給我任何一個夢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dream of the honey jar.
dialogue.zh: 那就夢見那罐蜂蜜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A jar of gold, very funny.
dialogue.zh: 一罐金子，真好笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You laughed, that helps too.
dialogue.zh: 你笑了，笑也有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My eyes are closing a little.
dialogue.zh: 我的眼睛正在一點一點閉起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not fight it, just drift.
dialogue.zh: 別撐著，就讓它慢慢下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, my phone is still ringing.
dialogue.zh: 等一下，我的手機還在響。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Who calls at this hour, really?
dialogue.zh: 說真的，誰這個時候打電話？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nobody, it is an old alarm sound.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊbədi ɪt ɪz ən oʊld əˈlɑrm saʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 沒人打，是以前設的鬧鐘在叫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Delete those alarms in the morning.
dialogue.zh: 早上再把那些鬧鐘刪掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The screen just lit up the room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə skrin dʒʌst lɪt ʌp ðə rum/
dialogue.zh: 手機螢幕剛剛把房間照亮了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn it face down, far from us.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ɪt feɪs daʊn fɑr frʌm ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 把它蓋過來，放遠一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Milk helped, now the phone breaks it.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɪlk hɛlpt naʊ ðə foʊn breɪks ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 牛奶才有效，結果手機來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow the phone sleeps elsewhere.
dialogue.zh: 從明天起，手機睡別的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Elsewhere is the hall, I think.
dialogue.zh: 別的地方就是走廊吧，我想。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The hall is perfect for phones.
dialogue.zh: 走廊最適合用來放手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No more sips, the milk is done.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ mɔr sɪps ðə mɪlk ɪz dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 不再喝了，牛奶已經喝完。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your cup is empty, sleep now.
dialogue.zh: 你的杯子都空了，快睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, the milk did its job.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，牛奶發揮作用了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The phone is next, then we rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə foʊn ɪz nɛkst ðɛn wi rɛst/
dialogue.zh: 接下來換手機，然後我們休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My jaw is tight from the cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ dʒɔ ɪz taɪt frʌm ðə koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 我的下巴因為冷而繃住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let it hang loose, like a cat.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ɪt hæŋ lus laɪk ə kæt/
dialogue.zh: 讓它鬆開，像貓一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A loose jaw, that is my gift.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə lus dʒɔ ðæt ɪz maɪ ɡɪft/
dialogue.zh: 鬆鬆的下巴，也算我的一項天賦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A great gift for a dark room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ɡreɪt ɡɪft fɔr ə dɑrk rum/
dialogue.zh: 對黑暗的房間來說是大禮物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cup smells sweet on the tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kʌp smɛlz swit ɑn ðə treɪ/
dialogue.zh: 托盤上的杯子還甜甜的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave it, the morning will wash it.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ɪt ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ wɪl wɑʃ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 先放著，早上再來洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us take the phone to the hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs teɪk ðə foʊn tə ðə hɔl/
dialogue.zh: 我們把手機拿到走廊去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I will carry the cable.
dialogue.zh: 好，充電線我來拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The outlet is behind the mirror.
dialogue.zh: 插座就在鏡子後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see it, the small round one.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ɪt ðə smɔl raʊnd wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 我看到了，那個圓圓的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plug it in, then walk back here.
dialogue.phonetic: /plʌɡ ɪt ɪn ðɛn wɔk bæk hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 插上去，然後走回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, it is far from the bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ɪt ɪz fɑr frʌm ðə bɛd/
dialogue.zh: 插好了，它離床很遠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How far is that, five whole steps?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ fɑr ɪz ðæt faɪv hoʊl stɛps/
dialogue.zh: 有多遠，五步嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seven, I counted on the way.
dialogue.zh: 七步，我一路數過來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seven steps is a good distance.
dialogue.zh: 七步算是很遠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Far enough to stop my hand.
dialogue.zh: 遠到我的手套不到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hand did reach it twice tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hænd dɪd ritʃ ɪt twaɪs təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 今晚我的手去拿過它兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is why the news kept coming.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz waɪ ðə nuz kɛpt ˈkʌmɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 所以新聞才一直跳出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The screen showed me a bright room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə skrin ʃod mi ə braɪt rum/
dialogue.zh: 螢幕一亮，房間像白天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue light says it is morning.
dialogue.zh: 藍光會跟身體說現在是早上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My brain believed it, of course.
dialogue.zh: 我的腦袋當然就信了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now it learns the dark again.
dialogue.zh: 現在它要重新認識黑暗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I turn the wifi off too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ tɜrn ðə ˈwaɪfaɪ ɔf tu/
dialogue.zh: 無線上網也要一起關掉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and close the message app.
dialogue.zh: 對，還有那個傳訊息的軟體。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wifi off, app closed, done.
dialogue.zh: 無線網關了，軟體也關了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very tidy, like a good soldier.
dialogue.zh: 真乾淨俐落，像個好士兵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The alarm on the wall clock works.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði əˈlɑrm ɑn ðə wɔl klɑk wɜrks/
dialogue.zh: 牆上那個鬧鐘一樣會響。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the phone can sleep there.
dialogue.zh: 那手機就可以睡在走廊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep there, in the cold hall.
dialogue.zh: 就叫它睡冷冷的走廊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Phones do not mind the cold.
dialogue.zh: 手機不在乎冷不冷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It minds, it loses battery fast.
dialogue.zh: 它在乎，電會掉得很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then charge it, do not watch it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn tʃɑrdʒ ɪt du nɑt wɑtʃ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那就讓它充電，別看著它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One bar left, from the evening.
dialogue.zh: 只剩一格電，從傍晚撐到現在。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It played videos all evening.
dialogue.zh: 它整個傍晚都在放影片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I watched the rain on the roof.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑtʃt ðə reɪn ɑn ðə ruf/
dialogue.zh: 我傍晚一直在看屋頂的雨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You watched rain through a screen?
dialogue.zh: 你是透過螢幕在看雨喔？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rain on a screen is only pixels.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪn ɑn ə skrin ɪz ˈoʊnli ˈpɪksəlz/
dialogue.zh: 螢幕上的雨只是小小的點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Real rain is free and louder.
dialogue.zh: 真的雨是免費的，又比較大聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Loud rain, quiet screen, choose.
dialogue.zh: 大雨聲跟安靜的螢幕，選一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The window is open, listen then.
dialogue.zh: 窗子是開的，你聽就知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Listening is better with closed eyes.
dialogue.zh: 閉著眼睛聽，感覺比較好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See, you are teaching yourself.
dialogue.zh: 你看，你自己在教你自己。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My thumb still wants to scroll.
dialogue.zh: 我的拇指還是想往下滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give the thumb a different job.
dialogue.zh: 就給拇指一份新的工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A different job, like holding yours.
dialogue.zh: 新的工作，例如牽著你的手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My hand is here, it is warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hænd ɪz hɪr ɪt ɪz wɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 我的手在這裡，它是溫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warmer than a phone, for sure.
dialogue.zh: 它一定比手機溫暖多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Phones never were warm friends.
dialogue.zh: 手機從來不是溫暖的朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It wakes me at six, too loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪt weɪks mi æt sɪks tu laʊd/
dialogue.zh: 它六點叫醒我，太大聲了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wall clocks ring soft, remember?
dialogue.zh: 牆上的鐘聲音比較軟，記得嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I do not remember, I never hear it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ du nɑt rɪˈmɛmbər aɪ ˈnɛvər hɪr ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我不記得，我根本都沒聽到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You hear it and hide under the blanket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju hɪr ɪt ænd haɪd ˈʌndər ðə ˈblæŋkɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你有聽到，只是躲在被子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got me, I do hide from six.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt mi aɪ du haɪd frʌm sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 被你抓到了，我的確躲六點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six is far when it is two.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ɪz fɑr wɛn ɪt ɪz tu/
dialogue.zh: 兩點的時候，六點好遙遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Very far, like another country.
dialogue.zh: 超遠，像另外一個國家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A country with soft grass.
dialogue.zh: 一個鋪滿軟草的國家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Grass, a bed, and no small screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡræs ə bɛd ænd noʊ smɔl skrin/
dialogue.zh: 有草、有床，沒有小螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A perfect country, then sleep.
dialogue.zh: 那是完美的國家，快睡吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hall light, is it still on?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hɔl laɪt ɪz ɪt stɪl ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 走廊那顆燈還亮著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, I shut it when I plugged.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ aɪ ʃʌt ɪt wɛn aɪ plʌɡd/
dialogue.zh: 沒有了，我插電的時候就關了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dark hall, bright room, or both dark?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɑrk hɔl braɪt rum ɔr boʊθ dɑrk/
dialogue.zh: 走廊暗、房間亮，還是兩個都暗？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both dark, that is the best mix.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ dɑrk ðæt ɪz ðə bɛst mɪks/
dialogue.zh: 兩個都黑，那是最好的組合。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My eyes need a minute of dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ aɪz nid ə ˈmɪnɪt ʌv dɑrk/
dialogue.zh: 我的眼睛需要一分鐘的黑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take two, I am right here.
dialogue.zh: 多坐兩分鐘吧，我就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two minutes, I will count them.
dialogue.zh: 兩分鐘，我會自己數著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not count, just sit and wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt kaʊnt dʒʌst sɪt ænd weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 別數了，坐著等就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sitting in the dark is strange.
dialogue.zh: 坐在黑暗裡有一點奇怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Strange for a week, then normal.
dialogue.zh: 怪一個禮拜，之後就習慣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A week is many nights of this.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə wik ɪz ˈmɛni naɪts ʌv ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 一個禮拜就是好多個晚上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Many, but softer each night.
dialogue.zh: 是很多晚，不過一晚比一晚輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It moved, the phone, in the hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt muvd ðə foʊn ɪn ðə hɔl/
dialogue.zh: 剛剛有東西動，是走廊的手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That was the cable slipping down.
dialogue.zh: 那是充電線滑下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Catch it before it hits the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /kætʃ ɪt bɪˈfɔr ɪt hɪts ðə flɔr/
dialogue.zh: 快接住，別讓它撞到地板。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, it hangs on the hook.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt ɪt hæŋz ɑn ðə hʊk/
dialogue.zh: 接住了，它掛在鉤子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A hook for the phone, nice idea.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə hʊk fɔr ðə foʊn naɪs aɪˈdiə/
dialogue.zh: 幫手機做一個鉤子，好主意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I put it there last month.
dialogue.zh: 上個月我就把它掛好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last month you were wise at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /læst mʌnθ ju wɜr waɪz æt naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 上個月你在半夜很聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wise for one night only.
dialogue.zh: 只有那個晚上聰明而已。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tonight we are wise together.
dialogue.zh: 今晚我們兩個都聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two wise people in one dark.
dialogue.zh: 同一個黑屋裡兩個聰明人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One rule more, if you allow.
dialogue.zh: 再多約一條規定，如果你願意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say it, I am listening still.
dialogue.zh: 你說，我還在聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No phone in the bed, ever again.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ foʊn ɪn ðə bɛd ˈɛvər əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 從今以後，手機不進床。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, it stays in the hall.
dialogue.zh: 同意，它就留在走廊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bed is for sleep and us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛd ɪz fɔr slip ænd ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 床是用來睡覺，還有給我們兩個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And for one small dreaming head.
dialogue.zh: 也給一顆要作夢的小腦袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My head may dream without news.
dialogue.zh: 我的腦袋可以不作新聞的夢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dream without the whole world.
dialogue.zh: 作夢的時候別背整個世界。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The world can wait until sunrise.
dialogue.zh: 世界可以等到太陽出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sunrise is four hours away.
dialogue.zh: 離日出還有四個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four hours of dark hall waiting.
dialogue.zh: 讓黑黑的走廊等四個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let it wait, you lie down.
dialogue.zh: 讓它等，你先躺下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Down I go, the bed wins again.
dialogue.phonetic: /daʊn aɪ ɡoʊ ðə bɛd wɪnz əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 我躺下了，床又贏了一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bed always wins, do not fight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛd ˈɔlweɪz wɪnz du nɑt faɪt/
dialogue.zh: 床一定會贏，別跟它吵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is soft in a new way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz sɔft ɪn ə nu weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 它變軟了，一種新的軟法。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No phone makes the bed softer.
dialogue.zh: 沒有手機，床會比較軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Softer, and my hands are free.
dialogue.zh: 變軟了，而且我的手空下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use them to hold the blanket.
dialogue.zh: 手空下來就去抱被子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Holding the blanket, done well.
dialogue.zh: 抱著被子，這個我做得好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very good, now close your eyes.
dialogue.zh: 很棒，現在把眼睛閉起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Closed. The hall light is off.
dialogue.zh: 閉上了，走廊的燈也關了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Off, and the door is open.
dialogue.zh: 關了，門我留開著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Open door, so the alarm carries.
dialogue.zh: 門開著，鬧鐘聲才傳得進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will hear six thirty well.
dialogue.zh: 六點半我們會聽得剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then let us write tomorrow first.
dialogue.zh: 那我們先把明天的事寫下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a list, then the eyes rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə lɪst ðɛn ði aɪz rɛst/
dialogue.zh: 好，寫個清單，眼睛就能休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the notebook, the paper one?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz ðə ˈnoʊtbʊk ðə ˈpeɪpər wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 筆記本在哪，紙本的那一本？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the desk, under the map.
dialogue.zh: 在書桌上，地圖的下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it, the cover is soft.
dialogue.zh: 找到了，封面軟軟的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue one, it holds your lists.
dialogue.zh: 藍色那本，專門放你的清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A pen too, the short green one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə pɛn tu ðə ʃɔrt ɡrin wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 也要一支筆，短的綠色那支。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It writes fine, do not squeeze.
dialogue.zh: 它很好寫，別用力捏它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My handwriting is bad at night.
dialogue.zh: 我晚上的字寫得很壞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine is worse, you can read yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn ɪz wɜrs ju kæn rid jɔrz/
dialogue.zh: 我的更壞，你至少還看得懂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Read this: milk, meeting, pay bill.
dialogue.zh: 唸一下：牛奶、開會、繳帳單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three lines, that is a good list.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri laɪnz ðæt ɪz ə ɡʊd lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 三行，這是一份好清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only three lines, you said that.
dialogue.zh: 只寫三行，是你說的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I did, more lines wake the brain.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dɪd mɔr laɪnz weɪk ðə breɪn/
dialogue.zh: 對，寫多了會讓腦袋醒來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lamp is too dim for this.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læmp ɪz tu dɪm fɔr ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 這盞燈太暗，寫不了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the desk light, lean close.
dialogue.zh: 用書桌那盞燈，身體靠近一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Close like this, is it enough?
dialogue.zh: 靠這麼近，亮度夠了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enough, I see your pen moving.
dialogue.zh: 夠了，我看得到你的筆在動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Date the top, we always forget.
dialogue.zh: 在最上面寫日期，我們總是忘記。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Today is Sunday, write tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 今天是星期日，寫明天的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Monday, the meeting is on Monday.
dialogue.zh: 星期一，會議是在星期一。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine o'clock, the first line.
dialogue.zh: 九點整，寫在第一行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First line, so it stops running.
dialogue.zh: 寫在第一行，它就不會一直跑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Written things walk out of the head.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪtn θɪŋz wɔk aʊt ʌv ðə hɛd/
dialogue.zh: 寫下來的東西會自己走出腦袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Out of the head, into the paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊt ʌv ðə hɛd ˈɪntu ðə ˈpeɪpər/
dialogue.zh: 從腦袋裡面，搬到紙上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Paper keeps it, screens do not.
dialogue.zh: 紙會留著它，螢幕不會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The second line is the bill.
dialogue.zh: 第二行是繳帳單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The electric one, due on Friday.
dialogue.zh: 電費那一張，星期五到期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday is safe, we have time.
dialogue.zh: 星期五很安全，我們還有時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Safe is good, worry less now.
dialogue.zh: 安全就好，現在少煩一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Third line: more milk, no honey.
dialogue.zh: 第三行：再買牛奶，不要蜂蜜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Honey stays, we have one jar.
dialogue.zh: 蜂蜜不用買，我們還有一罐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One jar of gold, my favorite.
dialogue.zh: 一罐金黃色的，是我的最愛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You still have half the jar.
dialogue.zh: 你那一罐還剩一半呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. The list is very short.
dialogue.zh: 寫完了，清單非常短。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Short lists make quiet heads.
dialogue.zh: 短的清單會讓腦袋安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My head is quieter, it is true.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hɛd ɪz ˈkwaɪətər ɪt ɪz tru/
dialogue.zh: 我的腦袋真的比較安靜了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See, paper does the work.
dialogue.zh: 你看，紙幫你做掉了工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cap the pen, it dries out.
dialogue.zh: 把筆蓋蓋上，它會乾掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cap it twice, then the drawer.
dialogue.zh: 蓋兩下，再放進抽屜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The drawer sticks, pull with me.
dialogue.zh: 抽屜卡住了，跟我一起拉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, it opened, all done.
dialogue.zh: 你看，開了，全部收好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pen in the drawer, now we lie.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɛn ɪn ðə drɔər naʊ wi laɪ/
dialogue.zh: 筆進了抽屜，我們來躺下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lie down, the list will wait.
dialogue.zh: 躺下來，清單會等你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It waits on the desk, right there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt weɪts ɑn ðə dɛsk raɪt ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 它在書桌上等，就在那個位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Far from the bed, good job.
dialogue.zh: 離床遠遠的，做得好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ink on my thumb again.
dialogue.zh: 我的拇指上又有墨水了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue ink, your sign at night.
dialogue.zh: 藍色墨水，你夜裡的記號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A small blue mark, like a star.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə smɔl blu mɑrk laɪk ə stɑr/
dialogue.zh: 一個藍色的小記號，像顆星星。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A star for a finished list.
dialogue.zh: 一顆星星，送給寫完的清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow I cross the lines out.
dialogue.zh: 明天我要把這些全劃掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cross them slow, that feels good.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢劃，那個感覺很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunlight helps me cross them.
dialogue.zh: 太陽會幫我把它們劃掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only three lines, remember.
dialogue.zh: 只有三行而已，記得喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Written, done, closed, away.
dialogue.zh: 寫了、做完、關上、放開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four words, and you sound light.
dialogue.zh: 四個字，你聽起來變輕了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I do sound light, it is odd.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ du saʊnd laɪt ɪt ɪz ɑd/
dialogue.zh: 我聽起來真的變輕了，好奇怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Odd things help at two thirty.
dialogue.zh: 奇怪的東西在兩點半很有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two thirty now, the list was quick.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈθɜrti naʊ ðə lɪst wəz kwɪk/
dialogue.zh: 已經兩點半了，清單寫得好快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quick list, long rest, that is the plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /kwɪk lɪst lɔŋ rɛst ðæt ɪz ðə plæn/
dialogue.zh: 清單快、休息久，這是我們的計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The plan needs one more thing.
dialogue.zh: 這個計畫還缺一樣東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Name it, I will help with it.
dialogue.phonetic: /neɪm ɪt aɪ wɪl hɛlp wɪð ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你說說看，我陪你做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, one more line popped in.
dialogue.zh: 等一下，腦裡又冒出一行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No more lines, the book is shut.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ mɔr laɪnz ðə bʊk ɪz ʃʌt/
dialogue.zh: 不能再加了，本子已經關上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is a small line, just six words.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ə smɔl laɪn dʒʌst sɪks wɜrdz/
dialogue.zh: 才一小行，只有六個字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six words become a whole hour.
dialogue.zh: 六個字會變成一整個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: True, I did that last month.
dialogue.zh: 真的，上個月我就是這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You wrote half the night away.
dialogue.zh: 上個月你寫掉了半個夜晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold the book, my hands are full.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ðə bʊk maɪ hændz ɑr fʊl/
dialogue.zh: 幫我扶著本子，我兩手都滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Full of what, ink and worry?
dialogue.zh: 滿手是什麼，墨水和煩惱嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both, and a cold nose.
dialogue.zh: 兩個都有，還有一個冷鼻子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then cover it, the book is safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈkʌvər ɪt ðə bʊk ɪz seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 那就蓋住鼻子，書我扶著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Safe with you, I trust books.
dialogue.zh: 放你那裡很安全，我信任書。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Books never ring at three.
dialogue.zh: 書才不會在三點響。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing rings now, the hall is dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ rɪŋz naʊ ðə hɔl ɪz dɑrk/
dialogue.zh: 現在沒東西響了，走廊黑黑的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then no one rings, no one writes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn noʊ wʌn rɪŋz noʊ wʌn raɪts/
dialogue.zh: 那沒人打來，也沒人要寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No more writing, I promise now.
dialogue.zh: 不再寫了，我現在保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say it to the closed cover.
dialogue.zh: 你對著關上的封面再說一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cover, I will not open you.
dialogue.zh: 封面啊，我不會再打開你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It felt funny, saying that.
dialogue.zh: 這樣講話有一點好笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Funny, but my head let go.
dialogue.zh: 好笑，不過我的腦袋放開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let go is the whole trick.
dialogue.zh: 放開就是全部的訣竅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The desk light can go off now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dɛsk laɪt kæn ɡoʊ ɔf naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 書桌的小燈可以關掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will reach it, stay there.
dialogue.zh: 我伸手去關，你坐著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dark again, and the notebook?
dialogue.zh: 又黑了，那筆記本怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Notebook on the desk, done.
dialogue.zh: 筆記本在書桌上，結束了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done is a good word at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ɪz ə ɡʊd wɜrd æt naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 完成了是夜裡最好的一句話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say it twice, it works better.
dialogue.zh: 多說兩次，效果會更好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Finished, finished, there, two.
dialogue.zh: 寫完了，寫完了，剛好兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very good, now your shoulders.
dialogue.zh: 很好，接著換你的肩膀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shoulders are still up high.
dialogue.zh: 我的肩膀還是聳得好高。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will count them down, slowly.
dialogue.zh: 我們數著把它放下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One, two, yes, they are lower.
dialogue.zh: 一、二，真的，它們變低了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, heavy and low now.
dialogue.zh: 對了，肩膀又重又沉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Resting still feels like work.
dialogue.zh: 休息起來還是像在工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then do one small thing more.
dialogue.zh: 那就再做一件小小的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One thing, and it must be easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn θɪŋ ænd ɪt mʌst bi ˈizi/
dialogue.zh: 一件就好，而且要非常簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe slow, that one is easy.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢呼吸，那個最簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Breathing, my oldest free tool.
dialogue.zh: 呼吸，我最老的免費工具。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free tools do not wake you.
dialogue.zh: 免費的工具不會把你吵醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then let us start it, together.
dialogue.zh: 那我們一起開始，兩個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Count them quietly, in fours.
dialogue.zh: 小聲數出來，四個一輪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn me onto my back, please.
dialogue.zh: 幫我翻身仰躺，拜託。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, flat, like a board.
dialogue.zh: 好了，平平的，像一塊板子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A pillow under my bent knees.
dialogue.zh: 膝蓋下面墊一顆小枕頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The small one fits just right.
dialogue.zh: 那顆小的剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My back lies flat on the bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ bæk laɪz flæt ɑn ðə bɛd/
dialogue.zh: 我的背平平貼在床面上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, now the arms go wide.
dialogue.zh: 很好，現在兩手臂打開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wide like wings, that is silly.
dialogue.zh: 張得像翅膀，好傻。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Silly things work, do not laugh.
dialogue.zh: 傻東西有效，別笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One hand up on my belly.
dialogue.zh: 一隻手放到肚子上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let it rise under your palm.
dialogue.zh: 讓它在你的手掌下起伏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It rises, look, like a small hill.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈraɪzəz lʊk laɪk ə smɔl hɪl/
dialogue.zh: 它鼓起來了，你看，像小山丘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A slow hill, up and down.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢的小山丘，起來又落下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Up for four, then down for six.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌp fɔr fɔr ðɛn daʊn fɔr sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 吸氣四拍，吐氣六拍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will say the numbers low.
dialogue.zh: 我把數字唸得很小聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Low is perfect, my ears are small.
dialogue.phonetic: /loʊ ɪz ˈpɜrfɪkt maɪ ɪrz ɑr smɔl/
dialogue.zh: 小聲剛剛好，我的耳朵很小。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four, and hold, then six out.
dialogue.zh: 四，停住，然後吐六拍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That was one round, only one.
dialogue.zh: 那才一輪，只有一輪而已。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten rounds make a sleepy man.
dialogue.zh: 十輪就會讓人變得很睏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleepy man, that is a new name.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈslɪpi mæn ðæt ɪz ə nu neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 想睡的男人，這是個新稱呼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A good name, it fits you.
dialogue.zh: 好稱呼，很適合你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shoulders next, they live by my ears.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃoʊldərz nɛkst ðeɪ lɪv baɪ maɪ ɪrz/
dialogue.zh: 接著是肩膀，它們住在耳朵旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell them to fall, just say it.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl ðɛm tə fɔl dʒʌst seɪ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 跟它們說掉下來，小聲說出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Down, shoulders, down, there we go.
dialogue.zh: 肩膀，掉下來，對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half an inch, I saw it move.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ən ɪntʃ aɪ sɔ ɪt muv/
dialogue.zh: 掉了半吋，我有看到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: An inch more, I am trying.
dialogue.zh: 再來一吋，我很努力了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know, your neck is long now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ jɔr nɛk ɪz lɔŋ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我知道，你的脖子現在變長了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Long neck, soft jaw, open mouth?
dialogue.zh: 長脖子、鬆下巴，嘴巴要張開嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mouth closed, tongue on the roof.
dialogue.zh: 嘴巴閉著，舌頭頂著上顎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My tongue was up there already.
dialogue.zh: 我的舌頭本來就頂在那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then your face can let go.
dialogue.zh: 那你的臉就可以放開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let go of your forehead now.
dialogue.zh: 額頭現在也放開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smooth, like the milk top.
dialogue.zh: 平平的，像牛奶上面那層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the eyes, they were tight.
dialogue.zh: 現在換眼睛，它們繃住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let them rest under the lids.
dialogue.zh: 讓它們在眼皮下面休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Resting eyes, warm hands, slow chest.
dialogue.zh: 眼睛在休息，手是溫的，胸口慢慢的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are doing all of it.
dialogue.zh: 你全部都在做了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almost all, my left foot itches.
dialogue.zh: 差一點全部，我的左腳在癢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ignore the foot, it will stop.
dialogue.zh: 別理那隻腳，它會自己停。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It stopped, strange, when I did nothing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt stɑpt streɪndʒ wɛn aɪ dɪd ˈnʌθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 真的停了，我什麼都沒做。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quiet feet stay where they are.
dialogue.zh: 安靜的腳會留在原本的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here on the bed, both of them.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɑn ðə bɛd boʊθ ʌv ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 就在床上，兩隻腳都在。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the blanket keeps them warm.
dialogue.zh: 被子會幫它們保溫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm feet, heavy legs, quiet hips.
dialogue.zh: 腳溫的、腿很重、臀部安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your body is lying still.
dialogue.zh: 你的身體真的躺平不動了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still, but my brain is up.
dialogue.zh: 身體靜了，我的腦袋還醒著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send it down with the next breath.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnd ɪt daʊn wɪð ðə nɛkst brɛθ/
dialogue.zh: 下一口氣就把它帶下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Down it went, on round seven.
dialogue.zh: 第七輪的時候它就下去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seven, you counted without me.
dialogue.zh: 七輪了，你都自己數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I lost you, then found you.
dialogue.zh: 我跟你走散了，然後又找到你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your breath was out of step.
dialogue.zh: 你的剛剛呼吸拍子不對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then slow mine, I will follow.
dialogue.zh: 那把你的放慢，我跟著做。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, in through the nose now.
dialogue.zh: 來，現在從鼻子吸進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In, and out, one more time.
dialogue.zh: 吸、吐，再來一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two more, then stop counting.
dialogue.zh: 再來兩次就不用了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stop counting, then what is left?
dialogue.zh: 不用數了，那還剩下什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just the bed, and the dark.
dialogue.zh: 只剩這張床，還有黑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dark, warm dark, like a box.
dialogue.zh: 黑黑的、溫暖的黑，像一個盒子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A soft box with two sleepers.
dialogue.zh: 一個軟盒子，裡面兩個要睡的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two now, maybe one soon.
dialogue.zh: 現在兩個，等一下也許只剩一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not race me to sleep.
dialogue.zh: 別跟我比賽誰先睡著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I never race, I walk slow.
dialogue.zh: 我從不比賽，我走得很慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You walked slow all evening.
dialogue.zh: 你整個傍晚都走得很慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even my shoulders walk slow.
dialogue.zh: 連我的肩膀都走很慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show them the pillow, then rest.
dialogue.zh: 讓枕頭去接它們，再休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pillow takes the head, done.
dialogue.zh: 枕頭接住頭了，好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The neck lies long and free.
dialogue.zh: 脖子長長地躺著，很自在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free hands, open on the blanket.
dialogue.zh: 手空空的，攤開在被子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Palms up, like catching rain.
dialogue.zh: 手心朝上，像在接雨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rain would be nice in July.
dialogue.zh: 七月的雨應該會很舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It already fell, an hour ago.
dialogue.zh: 一個小時前已經下過一場了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then the leaves are still wet.
dialogue.zh: 那樹上葉子現在還濕著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wet leaves and our quiet room.
dialogue.zh: 濕葉子，還有我們安靜的房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Quiet room, two slow breaths.
dialogue.zh: 安靜的房間，兩條慢呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three, or maybe four, mine joined.
dialogue.zh: 三條，也許四條，我也加進來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Together, it felt like a song.
dialogue.zh: 一起呼吸，感覺像一首歌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A slow song with no words.
dialogue.zh: 一首沒有歌詞的慢歌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No words left, my list is gone.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ wɜrdz lɛft maɪ lɪst ɪz ɡɑn/
dialogue.zh: 沒話說了，我的清單也不見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gone is fine, it stays on paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑn ɪz faɪn ɪt steɪz ɑn ˈpeɪpər/
dialogue.zh: 不見就好，它會留在紙上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paper holds it, I can float.
dialogue.zh: 紙幫我收著，我可以飄了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Float gently, the bed is near.
dialogue.zh: 輕輕飄，床就在旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Near, but my shoulder jumped up.
dialogue.zh: 很近，不過我的肩膀又跳起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send it down, no big deal.
dialogue.zh: 再把它放下來，沒有關係。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Down it goes, with the next six.
dialogue.phonetic: /daʊn ɪt ɡoʊz wɪð ðə nɛkst sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 吐六拍，它就掉下去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, flat again, both sides.
dialogue.zh: 你看，兩邊又平了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both sides level, that is new.
dialogue.zh: 兩邊都平了，這是新鮮事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your face did that too.
dialogue.zh: 你的臉也一起鬆開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Heavy face, heavy hands, heavy me.
dialogue.zh: 臉很重、手很重、我也很重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All heavy, so the bed works.
dialogue.zh: 全都沉沉的，床就開始做事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bed takes weight so well.
dialogue.zh: 床很會接住重量。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better than chairs, much softer.
dialogue.zh: 比椅子厲害，軟多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Softness, and one long breath.
dialogue.zh: 軟軟的，還有一口很長的呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The longest one tonight, I think.
dialogue.zh: 我想這是今晚最長的一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almost there, my eyes are wet.
dialogue.zh: 快到了，我的眼睛濕濕的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleepy wet, not sad wet, right?
dialogue.zh: 是想睡的濕，不是難過的濕，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, just tired, nothing else.
dialogue.zh: 對，只是睏，沒有別的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then rest the eyes for real.
dialogue.zh: 那就真的讓眼睛休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Real rest, I can hear you.
dialogue.zh: 真的休息了，我還聽到你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I whispered it, you heard it.
dialogue.zh: 我是小聲說的，你還是聽見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almost asleep, but one small thing.
dialogue.zh: 快睡著了，不過還有一件小事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say it, then we do it.
dialogue.zh: 你說，我們就一起去做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which book is the sleep one?
dialogue.zh: 哪一本是睡覺專用的書？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The heavy blue, on your left.
dialogue.zh: 厚厚那本藍色的，在你左手邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it, the spine makes a sound.
dialogue.phonetic: /faʊnd ɪt ðə spaɪn meɪks ə saʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 找到了，書背響了一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Paper breathing, nothing wrong.
dialogue.zh: 紙在呼吸，沒有壞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two pages only, that is the rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈpeɪdʒəz ˈoʊnli ðæt ɪz ðə rul/
dialogue.zh: 只翻兩頁，這是規則。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The rule says two, so two it is.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rul sɛz tu soʊ tu ɪt ɪz/
dialogue.zh: 規則說兩頁，那就是兩頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My eyes need the small light.
dialogue.zh: 我的眼睛需要一盞小燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The thin one, or the big one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə θɪn wʌn ɔr ðə bɪɡ wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 細的那盞，還是大的那盞？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The thin one, it points down only.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə θɪn wʌn ɪt pɔɪnts daʊn ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 細的那盞，光只往下照。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it low, the room stays dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪt loʊ ðə rum steɪz dɑrk/
dialogue.zh: 壓低一點，房間還是黑的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Page forty one, I lost my place.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪdʒ ˈfɔrti wʌn aɪ lɔst maɪ pleɪs/
dialogue.zh: 第四十一頁，我忘記唸到哪裡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a leaf inside, green.
dialogue.zh: 裡面夾了一張樹葉，綠色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A real leaf, pressed flat.
dialogue.zh: 一片真的樹葉，壓得平平的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From the park, last October.
dialogue.zh: 去年十月在公園撿的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: October is a good bookmark.
dialogue.zh: 十月的樹葉當書籤很合適。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better than paper slips.
dialogue.zh: 比紙條好用多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The book smells like a closet.
dialogue.zh: 這本書聞起來像衣櫃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old paper and a little dust.
dialogue.zh: 舊紙的味道，還有一點灰塵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dust, and someone's coffee stain.
dialogue.zh: 灰塵，還有某個人的咖啡漬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Page twelve, a brown ring.
dialogue.zh: 第十二頁，一個棕色圓圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone read this in the rain.
dialogue.zh: 以前有人在雨天裡讀過它。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or on a train, years ago.
dialogue.zh: 或是在火車上，好幾年前。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it is my turn with it.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪt ɪz maɪ tɜrn wɪð ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 現在換我來讀它了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only in bed, at this hour.
dialogue.zh: 只能躺在床上，這個時候。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Page forty one, the first of two.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪdʒ ˈfɔrti wʌn ðə fɜrst ʌv tu/
dialogue.zh: 第四十一頁，今晚翻的第一頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About a house by the sea.
dialogue.zh: 寫的是海邊的一間房子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A sea house, quiet people inside.
dialogue.zh: 海邊的房子，裡面的人很安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quiet people are perfect now.
dialogue.zh: 現在最剛好的就是安靜的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I read one line, then looked up.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ rɛd wʌn laɪn ðɛn lʊkt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 我讀了一行，就抬起頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The room is still the room.
dialogue.zh: 房間還是那個房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Words swim when the eyes get dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɜrdz swɪm wɛn ði aɪz ɡɛt draɪ/
dialogue.zh: 眼睛一乾，字就開始游動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blink twice, then find your line.
dialogue.zh: 眨兩下眼，再找到你那行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it, a sentence with rain.
dialogue.zh: 找到了，一句在寫雨的句子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read it soft, I like rain lines.
dialogue.phonetic: /rid ɪt sɔft aɪ laɪk reɪn laɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 小聲唸，我喜歡寫雨的句子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rain on the roof, she wrote.
dialogue.zh: 屋頂上有雨聲，她是這樣寫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, a woman who listens.
dialogue.zh: 不錯，一個會聽雨的女人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Second page is shorter here.
dialogue.zh: 這裡的第二頁比較短。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Short pages help tired eyes.
dialogue.zh: 短頁面對累了的眼睛有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn it slow, the paper bends.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢翻，紙正在彎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bend it back, it will not break.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛnd ɪt bæk ɪt wɪl nɑt breɪk/
dialogue.zh: 往回折一下，它不會破。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My thumb knows how to turn.
dialogue.zh: 我的拇指會自己翻頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Skill from a paper childhood.
dialogue.zh: 小時候翻紙本書練出來的手藝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Childhood, yes, I had a box.
dialogue.zh: 小時候啊，對，我有一個紙箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A box of books, or comics?
dialogue.zh: 一箱書，還是連環畫？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Comics, and one book about whales.
dialogue.zh: 連環畫，還有一本關於鯨魚的書。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Whales are good sleep company.
dialogue.zh: 鯨魚是很好的睡覺夥伴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Big animals, quiet in water.
dialogue.zh: 大動物，在水裡面很安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep like whales, then.
dialogue.zh: 那就學鯨魚那樣睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two pages done, look at that.
dialogue.zh: 兩頁讀完了，你看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two, exactly two, well done.
dialogue.zh: 兩頁，剛好兩頁，做得好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My eyes did not close once.
dialogue.zh: 我的眼睛一次都沒有閉起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now they want to, I can see.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðeɪ wɑnt tə aɪ kæn si/
dialogue.zh: 它們現在想閉了，我看得出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more line, the whale song.
dialogue.zh: 再一行就好，鯨魚那一段。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No more lines, close the book.
dialogue.zh: 不能再加了，把書關上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is open on my knee.
dialogue.zh: 書還開在我的膝蓋上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close it, keep the leaf inside.
dialogue.zh: 關起來，樹葉夾在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Closed, face down, keeps the page.
dialogue.zh: 關上、倒扣，就記住頁數了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old reader trick, that one.
dialogue.zh: 老讀者的祕訣，就是這招。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The table again for the book.
dialogue.zh: 書又放回小桌子上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right beside the water bottle.
dialogue.zh: 就放在水瓶的旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two pages every night, maybe.
dialogue.zh: 也許每天晚上兩頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe, and soon two becomes none.
dialogue.zh: 也許吧，很快兩頁就變成零頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: None, because the book closes itself.
dialogue.zh: 零頁，因為書會自己關起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The book is very polite, then.
dialogue.zh: 那本書還真有禮貌呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Polite books, loud phones.
dialogue.zh: 有禮貌的書，吵鬧的手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two neighbors, very different.
dialogue.zh: 兩個鄰居，差得非常遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Different, but both stay out of bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɪfərənt bʌt boʊθ steɪ aʊt ʌv bɛd/
dialogue.zh: 差很多，但兩個都不準上床。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The book too, on the table.
dialogue.zh: 書也是，留在桌上就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My spine is straight from sitting.
dialogue.zh: 坐著看書，我的背挺得直直的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lie back slow, the pillow is there.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪ bæk sloʊ ðə ˈpɪloʊ ɪz ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢躺回去，枕頭在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Down, and the ceiling again.
dialogue.zh: 躺平了，又看到天花板。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your old friend with the crack.
dialogue.zh: 你的老朋友，那條裂縫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tonight it looks like a boat.
dialogue.zh: 今晚那條裂縫像一艘船。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A boat on a dark sea, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə boʊt ɑn ə dɑrk si ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那就是黑海面上的一艘船。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We sail at two forty now.
dialogue.zh: 兩點四十，我們出海了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sail slow, no waves in here.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢開，這裡沒有浪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands are empty now.
dialogue.zh: 我的兩手現在是空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Empty hands sleep the best.
dialogue.zh: 空空的雙手睡得最舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing in them, no pen, no phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ ɪn ðɛm noʊ pɛn noʊ foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 裡面什麼都沒有，沒有筆，沒有手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No book either, that is all.
dialogue.zh: 書也沒有了，這樣就對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All done, the pages rest.
dialogue.zh: 都收好了，那些頁面在休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They read enough for tonight.
dialogue.zh: 它們今晚已經讀夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Words stay in my ears.
dialogue.zh: 那些字還留在我耳朵裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rain words, or whale words?
dialogue.zh: 是雨的字，還是鯨魚的字？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both, mixed like the milk.
dialogue.zh: 兩種都有，像牛奶攪在一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Milk and whales, a strange pair.
dialogue.zh: 牛奶跟鯨魚，一對奇怪的組合。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Strange pairs sleep best too.
dialogue.zh: 奇怪的配對也睡得最好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two strange people, one bed.
dialogue.zh: 兩個奇怪的人，一張床。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lamp can rest, too.
dialogue.zh: 燈也可以休息了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First the eyes, then the switch.
dialogue.zh: 先讓眼睛休息，再關開關。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soon, but the book cover first.
dialogue.zh: 等一下，先把書封放好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cover is flat on the table.
dialogue.zh: 書封已經平平在桌上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, everything is put away.
dialogue.zh: 真好，全部都收好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everything except your thoughts.
dialogue.zh: 除了你的思緒還沒收。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My thoughts can sit with the book.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ θɔts kæn sɪt wɪð ðə bʊk/
dialogue.zh: 我的思緒可以坐在書旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit them down, right there.
dialogue.zh: 請它們坐好，就在那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, the switch, and dark.
dialogue.zh: 現在，關開關，然後全黑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will reach over, do not move.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ritʃ ˈoʊvər du nɑt muv/
dialogue.zh: 我伸手過去，你別動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ready for the dark, I think.
dialogue.zh: 我準備好要進到黑暗裡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let it fall, all dark.
dialogue.zh: 那就讓它落下來，全黑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you find it, the switch?
dialogue.zh: 你摸到那個開關了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One click, and the room is dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn klɪk ænd ðə rum ɪz dɑrk/
dialogue.zh: 一聲輕響，房間就全黑了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the ceiling has gone away.
dialogue.zh: 現在天花板躲起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The crack is hiding in the dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kræk ɪz ˈhaɪdɪŋ ɪn ðə dɑrk/
dialogue.zh: 那道裂縫藏在黑暗裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I cannot see my own hands.
dialogue.zh: 我看不見自己的兩隻手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are resting under the blanket.
dialogue.zh: 它們正在毯子底下休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My toes stop their little tapping.
dialogue.zh: 我的腳趾不再輕輕敲了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, they were busy all night.
dialogue.zh: 很好，它們整晚忙個不停。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shoulders down, jaw loose, both eyes soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃoʊldərz daʊn dʒɔ lus boʊθ aɪz sɔft/
dialogue.zh: 肩膀沉下來，下巴鬆開，雙眼放軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You sound like a melting candle.
dialogue.zh: 你聽起來像一支慢慢融化的蠟燭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bed holds me like a bowl.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛd hoʊldz mi laɪk ə boʊl/
dialogue.zh: 床像一隻碗那樣托住我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A deep bowl, warm and soft.
dialogue.zh: 一隻很深、很軟、很暖的碗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slippers are back under the bed.
dialogue.zh: 拖鞋已經回到床底下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They waited there all this time.
dialogue.zh: 它們一直在那裡等我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: List is safe on the desk, done.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪst ɪz seɪf ɑn ðə dɛsk dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 清單安全地放在書桌上，寫完了。
