dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow can read it itself.
dialogue.zh: 明天它自己會去讀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No ring now, the phone sits far away.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ rɪŋ naʊ ðə foʊn sɪts fɑr əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 現在不會響了，手機坐在遠遠的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six thirty will call us later.
dialogue.zh: 六點半才會來叫我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set the alarm, then let it be.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ði əˈlɑrm ðɛn lɛt ɪt bi/
dialogue.zh: 鬧鐘設好之後，就隨它去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is set, now close your eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz sɛt naʊ kloʊz jɔr aɪz/
dialogue.zh: 設好了，現在把眼睛閉起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Darkness feels bigger than before.
dialogue.zh: 黑暗感覺比剛才更大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bigger dark, softer edges.
dialogue.zh: 更大的黑暗，更軟的邊界。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No more clock for my eyes tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ mɔr klɑk fɔr maɪ aɪz təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 今晚我的眼睛不用再找時鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, the clock can sleep too.
dialogue.zh: 很好，時鐘也要睡覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rain is thinner now, almost gone.
dialogue.zh: 雨變細了，幾乎要停。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A car went by, then no sound.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə kɑr wɛnt baɪ ðɛn noʊ saʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 一輛車開過去，然後就沒有聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Breathing slow, in for four counts.
dialogue.zh: 呼吸放慢，吸氣數四拍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Out for six, that is better.
dialogue.zh: 吐氣數六拍，這樣比較舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My ribs have stopped their tight work.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ rɪbz hæv stɑpt ðɛr taɪt wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 我的肋骨不再使勁了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They can rest until morning.
dialogue.zh: 它們可以休息到早上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pillow is cool on this side.
dialogue.zh: 枕頭這一邊涼涼的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flip it, the other is cooler.
dialogue.zh: 翻個面，另一邊更涼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blanket edge sits right on my chin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈblæŋkɪt ɛdʒ sɪts raɪt ɑn maɪ tʃɪn/
dialogue.zh: 毯子的邊剛好停在我的下巴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect height, warm at the neck.
dialogue.zh: 高度剛剛好，頸子是暖的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Legs are heavy, filled with sand.
dialogue.zh: 腿好重，像裝滿了沙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Heavy legs carry good dreams.
dialogue.zh: 很重的腿正好帶著好夢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both hands lie flat, palms up.
dialogue.zh: 兩手平平躺著，掌心朝上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open hands hold nothing at all.
dialogue.zh: 張開的手什麼都不肯拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tongue loose, teeth apart, cheeks soft.
dialogue.zh: 舌頭鬆開，牙齒分開，臉頰放軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are talking to yourself again.
dialogue.zh: 你又在自己跟自己說話了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almost, my thoughts moved downstairs.
dialogue.zh: 差不多了，我的念頭下樓去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Downstairs is dark too, let them go.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌdaʊnˈstɛrz ɪz dɑrk tu lɛt ðɛm ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 樓下也是黑的，讓它們去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honey jar is back on the shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhʌni dʒɑr ɪz bæk ɑn ðə ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 蜂蜜罐已經放回架子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sweet morning will find it there.
dialogue.zh: 甜甜的早上會在那裡找到它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Milk cup waits by the sink.
dialogue.zh: 牛奶杯在洗碗池邊等著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Morning water will rinse it clean.
dialogue.zh: 早上的清水會把它沖乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My eyes are heavy now, finally.
dialogue.zh: 我的眼睛好重，終於來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close them, I will keep watch.
dialogue.zh: 閉上吧，我在旁邊替你看著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The whale book is face down.
dialogue.zh: 鯨魚那本書已經蓋著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Whales can swim in dreams instead.
dialogue.zh: 鯨魚可以去夢裡面游。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: October leaf still marks my page.
dialogue.zh: 那片十月的樹葉還夾在我那頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It can rest with the book.
dialogue.zh: 就讓它跟書一起休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Room smells of milk and paper now.
dialogue.phonetic: /rum smɛlz ʌv mɪlk ænd ˈpeɪpər naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 房間現在有牛奶和紙的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A clean smell, a sleepy smell.
dialogue.zh: 乾淨的味道，想睡的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell me something soft, anything at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl mi ˈsʌmθɪŋ sɔft ˈɛniθɪŋ ət ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 跟我說點柔軟的事，什麼都好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your hair makes a quiet shape.
dialogue.zh: 你的頭髮散成很安靜的形狀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say that again, but slower.
dialogue.zh: 那句話再說一次，說慢一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow is my best voice tonight.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢講是我今晚最好的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Knees are bent, hips are loose.
dialogue.zh: 膝蓋彎著，胯也鬆開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loose hips sink into the mattress.
dialogue.zh: 鬆開的胯慢慢沉進床墊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mattress keeps the shape of us.
dialogue.zh: 床墊記得我們的形狀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our shape, pressed in by many nights.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊr ʃeɪp prɛst ɪn baɪ ˈmɛni naɪts/
dialogue.zh: 我們的形狀，是好多個夜壓出來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Side sleeper tonight, or on my back?
dialogue.phonetic: /saɪd ˈsliːpər təˈnaɪt ɔr ɑn maɪ bæk/
dialogue.zh: 今晚側著睡，還是躺平？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your side, that is where you snore.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr saɪd ðæt ɪz wɛr ju snɔr/
dialogue.zh: 側著那一邊呀，那是你打呼的位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I did not snore, I breathed.
dialogue.zh: 我沒有打呼，我只是在呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathing like a small engine, yes.
dialogue.zh: 像一台小引擎那樣呼吸，是吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Engine or not, sleep is coming.
dialogue.zh: 管它是不是引擎，睡意要來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coming slow, like water filling a cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌmɪŋ sloʊ laɪk ˈwɔtər ˈfɪlɪŋ ə kʌp/
dialogue.zh: 來得很慢，像水注滿一個杯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing, the window is open.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr θɪŋ ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ɪz ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，窗戶開著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It stays open just a crack.
dialogue.zh: 窗只留一條小縫，雨在外面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cool air on my forehead, nice.
dialogue.zh: 涼涼的風在我額頭上，舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not let it reach your neck.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt lɛt ɪt ritʃ jʊr nɛk/
dialogue.zh: 別讓風一直吹到你的脖子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Neck is fine, shoulders sunk again.
dialogue.zh: 脖子沒事，肩膀又沉下去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sunk deep, like warm flour.
dialogue.zh: 沉得深深的，像一碗溫的麵粉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm flour, that is a strange line.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm ˈflaʊər ðæt ɪz ə streɪndʒ laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 溫的麵粉，這句話真奇怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Strange lines are my best ones.
dialogue.zh: 奇怪的話正是我拿手的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleepy already, and I did not try.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈslɪpi ɔlˈrɛdi ænd aɪ dɪd nɑt traɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我已經想睡了，什麼都沒試。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trying was the problem, you know.
dialogue.zh: 刻意去試才是問題，你知道的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No more trying, just this bed.
dialogue.zh: 不再試了，就只有這張床。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just the bed, and my shoulder.
dialogue.zh: 只有床，還有我的肩膀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We need milk tomorrow, right?
dialogue.zh: 明天我們需要牛奶，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow has milk, sleep first.
dialogue.zh: 明天有牛奶，先睡覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Alarm is six thirty, far away.
dialogue.zh: 鬧鐘設在六點半，還很遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six thirty is very far right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈθɜrti ɪz ˈvɛri fɑr raɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 六點半現在離得好遠好遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Breathing is slower than yours now.
dialogue.zh: 我的呼吸現在比你的慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yours wins, I counted four.
dialogue.zh: 是你贏了，我數到四拍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am dreaming of blue water.
dialogue.zh: 我開始夢見藍色的水了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue water, or the whale again?
dialogue.zh: 藍色的水，還是那頭鯨魚？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Whale, yes, she leaps in it.
dialogue.zh: 是鯨魚，牠正在躍出水面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quiet, tell her later, close your eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪət tɛl hɜr ˈleɪtər kloʊz jʊr aɪz/
dialogue.zh: 小聲點，之後再告訴她，先閉眼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eyes closed, lids warm, breathing low.
dialogue.zh: 眼睛閉著，眼皮暖暖的，呼吸很輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Low and steady, that is sleep.
dialogue.zh: 又輕又穩，那就是睡來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night, my partner in the dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naɪt maɪ ˈpɑrtnər ɪn ðə dɑrk/
dialogue.zh: 晚安，黑暗裡我的夥伴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Night night, you finally did it.
dialogue.zh: 睡吧睡吧，你終於做到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half asleep, I hear your voice.
dialogue.zh: 半睡半醒，我聽見你的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My voice is going quiet now.
dialogue.zh: 我的聲音現在要變得很輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say nothing more, just stay here.
dialogue.zh: 什麼都別再說了，留在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, under the quilt, beside you.
dialogue.zh: 在這裡，被子下面，你的旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep now, the room is safe.
dialogue.zh: 睡吧，這個房間很安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Safe, dark, and morning is hours off.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪf dɑrk ænd ˈmɔrnɪŋ ɪz ˈaʊərz ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 安全、黑黑的，早上還有好幾個小時。
